dataList.title: Fetch the Hide
dataList.description: The Overseer requested 8 pieces of hide in return for making the Golden Shroud. We need to gather the hides scattered across the Grand Magasin.

dataList.title: Collect the Pieces of Golden Hide
dataList.description: We encountered the Overseer on B3F. The Overseer said that in order to make clothing from the Golden Hide, we need to collect the pieces from all the location we've visited so far. The exact locations were given to us. Now we need to go fetch the Golden Hide for the Overseer.

steps.goalDescription2: Collect B2F Floor Manager's Golden Hide
steps.goalDescription3: Collect the King of Needlework's Golden Hide
steps.goalDescription5: Collect the Golden Hide from 1F's corpse pile
steps.goalDescription6: Collect the Golden Hide from the wall on 4F
steps.goalDescription7: Collect the Golden Hide from the Rouge Brand Director's corpse
steps.goalDescription8: Collect the Golden Hide from 3F's Floor Manager

dataList.title: Gather the Hide - B1F
dataList.description: One of the eight pieces of hide demanded by the Overseer can be found on B1F. It has to be flayed off the Sous Chef.

dataList.title: Gather the Hide - 1F
dataList.description: One of the eight pieces of hide demanded by the Overseer can be found on 1F. It should be somewhere in the corpse pile.

steps.goalDescription1: Find the Golden Hide hidden in the corpse pile (5/8)

dataList.title: Gather the Hide - 2F
dataList.description: One of the eight pieces of hide demanded by the Overseer can be found on 2F. It has to be flayed off the Brand Director.

steps.goalDescription1: Take the Brand Director's Golden Hide (7/8)

dataList.title: Gather the Hide - 3F
dataList.description: One of the eight pieces of hide demanded by the Overseer can be found on 3F. It has to be flayed off the Floor Manager.

dataList.title: Gather the Hide - 4F
dataList.description: One of the eight pieces of hide demanded by the Overseer can be found on 4F. We should search through the concrete rubble left behind by the Deconstructionists.

steps.goalDescription1: Pick up the Golden Hide stuffed inside the crack in the wall (6/8)
steps.goalDescription2: Obtained Golden Hide from the crack in the wall (6/8)

dataList.title: Return to the Overseer
dataList.description: We've finally procured all eight pieces of the Golden Hide. Let's return to the Overseer on B3F and hand over what we've collected so he can craft Pwie an outfit out of the Golden Hide.

dataList.title: Head to the Tannery
dataList.description:
We've brought all eight pieces of the Golden Hide, but our journey didn't end there. To make bespoke garment, said the Overseer, Pwie should first head to the Tannery and get their size measured.
Let's head to the Tannery and meet the... Tanner.

steps.goalDescription1: Hold the position against the onslaught of enemies until the patterning process is completed.

dataList.title: Head to the Cutting Room
dataList.description:
Pwie's size has been measured, and patterns have been patterned. Now, it's time for cutting and sewing.

Let's head to the Cutting Room.

steps.goalDescription1: Hold the position against the onslaught of enemies until the cutting process is completed.

dataList.title: Finish the Sewing Process
dataList.description: The cutting is complete. Once the Nurturer handles the stitching, the Golden Hide garment should be finished.

steps.goalDescription1: Hold off the incoming enemies until the Nurturer finishes stitching

dataList.title: Receive the Golden Shroud from the Overseer
dataList.description: Looks like the whole process is complete. We should collect the finished garment from the Overseer.

steps.goalDescription1: Receive the Golden Shroud from the Overseer

dataList.title: Kill the Overseer
dataList.description: The Overseer finished the Golden Hide garment, but apparently couldn't bear to hand it over and turned on us instead. We should defeat the Overseer and claim the finished garment.

dataList.title: Head to 5F
dataList.description:
The Overseer completed the Golden Hide, allowing Pwie to don clothing made from it. Pwie, however, doesn't seem glad at all after devouring Wriggley.
... It's time to head to 5F.

steps.goalDescription1: See the tanning process through to completion

dataList.title: Negotiate with Sous Chef again
dataList.description: The consequence of giving up the arm was too dire. Let's return to Sous Chef on B1F's Food Court and offer her another trade.
